title: Workflow info object with basic workflow details
description: WorkflowInfo schema from WSO2 API Manager

workflowType.description: Type of the Workflow Request. It shows which type of request is it.

workflowStatus.description: Show the Status of the the workflow request whether it is approved or created.

createdTime.description: Time of the the workflow request created.

updatedTime.description: Time of the the workflow request updated.

referenceId.description: Workflow external reference is used to identify the workflow requests uniquely.

description.description: description is a message with basic details about the workflow request.
description.example: Approve application [APP1] creation request from application creator - admin with throttling tier - 10MinPer
